summary: Controlled re-entry after extended break and back strain — three 30-min sessions, all easy/moderate, rebuild habit and protect recovery.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Rebuild aerobic movement habit at Z2, conversational effort

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 80-85 rpm, HR <145 bpm — let legs wake up
Z2 steady aerobic, 85-90 rpm, HR 146-162 bpm — conversational pace throughout
Z1 soft pedal, drop cadence, HR settle below 130 bpm

sessions.name: Anti-Flexion Lower Body & Core
sessions.focus: Lower body and core activation — spine-neutral, no spinal flexion under load, back-safe re-entry
sessions.notes: 2 rounds: 10x Goblet Squat 6kg (spine tall), 8/side TRX Split Squat (upright torso), 15x Banded Glute Bridge (squeeze at top), 20m x2 Farmer's Carry 6kg each hand (anti-lateral core brace), 6/side Dead Bug (slow and controlled). 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. NO spinal flexion under load. Stop any exercise that causes back discomfort and report.

steps.description: Hip circles 10 each direction, lateral leg swings 10/side, bodyweight glute bridge 15 reps, slow bodyweight squat 10 reps focusing on posture
Goblet Squat 6kg x10 → TRX Split Squat x8/side → Banded Glute Bridge x15 → Farmer's Carry 6kg x20m (x2 lengths) → Dead Bug x6/side. 60s rest between exercises.
90 seconds rest between rounds — walk around, breathe, check back feels neutral
90/90 hip stretch 45s/side, standing quad stretch 30s/side, modified child's pose on fists (no lumbar flexion — forehead on folded arms)

sessions.name: Easy Run Z1–Z2
sessions.focus: Low-intensity aerobic stimulus, reintroduce running movement pattern with back-safe posture

steps.description: Brisk walk, Z1 — tall spine, relaxed shoulders, HR <130 bpm
Z1-Z2 easy running >6:45/km, HR <155 bpm — walk 60s if HR exceeds 160 bpm, short strides, light core brace, nasal breathing where possible
Walk, HR below 120 bpm before stopping — check back for any discomfort

summary: Continue base build — extend cycling duration slightly, add a second strength round, and reinforce running habit. Still 80% easy, no intensity.

sessions.name: Aerobic Endurance Spin
sessions.focus: Extended Z2 aerobic block, 30 min at sustained 110-130W

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Progress to 3 Rounds
sessions.focus: Add third round at same loads, build volume tolerance, spine-neutral

sessions.name: Easy Run with Strides
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 run with 4x15s relaxed strides at end — neuromuscular activation

summary: Introduce first threshold stimulus on the bike — one Z3 sweet-spot block within a 30-min ride. Strength moves to 8-11kg on key lifts. Run stays easy.

sessions.name: Sweet Spot Introduction
sessions.focus: 2x8 min at Z3 sweet spot (142-160W), long recovery — first threshold stimulus

sessions.name: Lower Body Strength — Load Progression
sessions.focus: Progress to 11kg goblet squat and carries, add single-leg RDL with 6kg

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 sustained easy run, 25-30 min, HR-controlled

summary: Recovery week — cut volume 40%, drop all intensity, easy movement only. Let adaptation from the 3-week base block consolidate before next cycle.

sessions.name: Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Z1 only, <110W, 20-25 min — flush legs, no stimulus

sessions.name: Mobility & Light Activation
sessions.focus: Bodyweight only — hip mobility, dead bugs, glute bridges, TRX rows light — no loading

sessions.name: Easy Walk-Run
sessions.focus: 20 min walk-run at Z1, pure recovery movement
